summary.en: Gunmen abducted five people and shot two in a Plateau community while bandits abducted three in Wase, Plateau and killed a 3‑year-old girl in Zamfara after a kidnapping. In Kaduna, IDPs demanded the release of four abducted members still held captive and bandits killed a farmer after receiving a N56 million ransom. Armed thugs attacked Peter Obi opposition rallies and NDC supporters in Lagos, killing supporters and prompting a police probe. AI-generated disinformation is now influencing the upcoming elections, adding a new information-war dimension. The conflict recorded 1,486 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.title: Boko Haram insurgency
background.extract: The Boko Haram insurgency began in July 2009, when the militant Islamist and jihadist rebel group Boko Haram started an armed rebellion against the government of Nigeria. Boko Haram targets both Muslims and Christians. Attacks are often directed at individuals perceived as supporting the Nigerian government or Islamic State after the split between them, including civil servants, local defense groups, Muslim leaders who oppose the group and other rebels like al-Qaeda and Islamic State. Most attacks are not based on the religion of the victims.
